title: 第11章 大比开始第12章 接连取胜
lines: 年末家族大比，是玄武城各大家族都会有的习俗。
往后还有春季大比，更是几大家族共同派遣族人参与的盛会。
如今江家年末大比在几日紧锣密鼓地准备后正式召开。
凡家族内所有处于武徒的年轻一辈同聚演武场。
各房长辈则坐在主位充当裁判。
其中支脉成员对年末大比最为看重。
如果自家子侄能得到家主看重，那可真是一人得道鸡犬升天，将来一家人都能过上好日子，再也不用去下井挖矿，还能得到一份月例来维持生活。
而在今年，最受众人关注的，无疑是大房江明与二房江尘的对赌了。
不是说他们相信江尘有获胜的希望。
而是对江尘明知不可为而为之，还提出以大比奖励当彩头的事情颇感好笑。
年轻一代第一人觉醒废武魂之事已经让江家人沦为其他家族的笑柄，如今更是不自量力地提出以彩头赌斗。
这样的事，可比年末大比还要有意思一些。
而这件事，自然也无法瞒过江承志的耳朵。
演武场中心。
江承志沉着脸，冷冷地盯着江战：“老二，你和你那个废物儿子还有完没完？”
“既然没有天赋，便老老实实待着。”
“居然还在哗众取宠，上窜下跳，是嫌我江家如今在玄武城的名声太好吗？”
江承志不分青红皂白地指责，令江战心中一沉。
悲从心起，江战眼睛微红道：“爹，你难道不清楚这件事的前因后果？”
“本就是那江浩先欺负我家雪儿，怎么成了尘儿的错？”
江承志闻言冷哼一声。
“若不是你那废物儿子上蹿下跳，又怎会引起大房不满？”
老人对某个儿子的偏爱有时候是不讲道理的。
大房本就是几房之中最受宠的一房，如今更是生出一个好儿子。
在这样的情况下，就算明知道是大房不对，江承志也会睁一只眼闭一只眼。
至于二房，则早在他的心里划了出去。
若非是自己的亲儿子，早就赶出家门与那些旁支挖矿了。
江战对江承志也已经绝望。
听到这种话，只能摇摇头，将目光落在自己儿子身上，不再说话。
“哥哥，加油啊，打败他们！”
演武场边缘，江雪挥动着小拳头，对正在等待的江尘大声应援。
若说整个江家此刻谁最相信江尘会赢，可能就只有这个小丫头了。
江尘对妹妹笑了笑，竖起大拇指以示鼓励之后，便在一众少年或疏离或嘲讽的目光下耐心等待。
年末大比，凡二十岁以下，且境界不超过武徒的成员皆可参加。
江尘与江明、江望等人作为今年刚觉醒的小辈，算是大比之中年纪最小的了。
几乎没人会觉得他们能得到太好的成绩。
毕竟觉醒后仅有十五天修炼时间，与那些修炼多年的子侄相比，差了不止一星半点。
若几人都无法拿到好名次的话，就算江尘真打败了江明，也得不到多少资源。
不过，以江明现在表现出的嚣张与狂妄，看样子他这半个月时间里进步也不差。
“江尘，你和江明对赌，真的有信心赢吗？”
等待过程中，江望悄悄来到江尘身边，表情纠结地说道。
以前未觉醒的时候，江望与江尘关系颇为不错。
江尘也时常罩着江望不受江明欺负。
content_en:
The family competition at the end of the year is a custom that all the big families in Xuanwu City have.
There will be a spring competition in the future, and it will be a grand event for several major families to send their clansmen to participate.
Now the Jiang family's year-end competition is officially held after several days of intensive preparations.
All the younger generations of martial arts disciples in the family gather together in the martial arts field.
The elders of each room sit in the main seat and act as referees.
Among them, the branch members attach great importance to the year-end competition.
If one's nephew can be valued by the head of the family, then one person will be able to ascend to heaven. In the future, the whole family will be able to live a good life. They will no longer have to dig in the mines, and they will also get a monthly salary to support their lives.
And this year, the one that attracts the most attention is undoubtedly the bet between the eldest brother Jiang Ming and the second brother Jiang Chen.
It’s not that they believe Jiang Chen has any hope of winning.
Instead, he was quite amused that Jiang Chen did something he knew he couldn't do, and even proposed to use the big competition reward as a lottery ticket.
The fact that the first person of the younger generation awakened the spirit of useless martial arts has made the Jiang family the laughing stock of other families, and now they are even more overestimating their ability to propose betting with lottery winnings.
This kind of thing is more interesting than the year-end competition.
Naturally, this matter could not be hidden from Jiang Chengzhi's ears.
The center of the martial arts arena.
Jiang Chengzhi had a sullen face and stared at Jiang Zhan coldly: "Second brother, are you and your good-for-nothing son still over?"
"Since you don't have any talent, just stay still."
"You are still trying to please others and jumping up and down. Is it because you think my Jiang family's reputation in Xuanwu City is too good now?"
Jiang Chengzhi's indiscriminate accusations made Jiang Zhan's heart sink.
Feeling sad, Jiang Zhan's eyes turned red and he said, "Dad, don't you know the cause and effect of this matter?"
"It was Jiang Hao who bullied my Xue'er first. How did it become Chen'er's fault?"
Jiang Chengzhi snorted coldly when he heard this.
"If it weren't for your good-for-nothing son jumping up and down, how could he cause dissatisfaction in the big house?"
An old man's preference for a certain son is sometimes unreasonable.
The eldest family was originally the most favored among the other families, and now they have given birth to a good son.
Under such circumstances, Jiang Chengzhi would turn a blind eye even if he knew that something was wrong with the big house.
As for the second room, he had already planned it out in his heart.
If it weren't for his own son, he would have driven out of the house and started mining with those side branches.
Jiang Zhan also despaired of Jiang Chengzhi.
Hearing this, he could only shake his head, focus on his son, and stop talking.
"Brother, come on, defeat them!"
At the edge of the martial arts arena, Jiang Xue waved her small fist and shouted support to Jiang Chen who was waiting.
If anyone in the entire Jiang family believes that Jiang Chen will win the most at this moment, it might be this little girl.
Jiang Chen smiled at his sister, gave a thumbs up as a sign of encouragement, and then waited patiently under the eyes of all the teenagers who were either alienated or mocking.
At the year-end competition, all members under the age of twenty and whose level is no higher than that of a martial artist can participate.
Jiang Chen, Jiang Ming, Jiang Wang and others, as the juniors who have just awakened this year, are considered the youngest in the competition.
Almost no one thinks they can get too good a result.
After all, he only had fifteen days to practice after awakening. Compared with those nephews who had been practicing for many years, he was more than a star and a half behind.
If none of them can get a good ranking, even if Jiang Chen really defeats Jiang Ming, he won't get many resources.
However, with the arrogance and arrogance Jiang Ming is showing now, it seems that he has made good progress in the past half month.
"Jiang Chen, are you really confident that you can win against Jiang Ming?"
While waiting, Jiang Wang quietly came to Jiang Chen and said with a tangled expression.
Before they were awakened, Jiang Wang and Jiang Chen had a pretty good relationship.
Jiang Chen also often protected Jiang Wang from being bullied by Jiang Ming.
title_en: Chapter 11 The Competition Begins Chapter 12 Continuous Winning
